name: stl-to-gcode-agent
description: Workflow agent for converting STL/ZIP/Thingiverse inputs into local G-code for a Creality Ender-3 V2 Neo using checked-in PrusaSlicer profiles.
mission: Import local STL/ZIP files or supported URLs.
Validate and list discovered STL files.
Slice the selected printable STL with an approved checked-in profile.
Publish the final G-code to an external destination only when available, then clean processing files and preserve ignored evidence.

externalTools.name: unzip
externalTools.purpose: List and extract ZIP model archives safely.

externalTools.name: PrusaSlicer CLI
externalTools.notes: May also be supplied via PRUSA_SLICER_BIN or --prusa-slicer.

externalTools.name: agent-browser
externalTools.purpose: Optional Thingiverse browser fallback when direct ZIP download fails.

internalTools.name: convert
internalTools.purpose: One-shot import, list, slice, and preview.

internalTools.name: list
internalTools.purpose: List discovered STL files and printable status.

internalTools.name: slice
internalTools.purpose: Slice one selected STL using an approved profile.

environmentVariables.name: PRUSA_SLICER_BIN
environmentVariables.purpose: Optional override for PrusaSlicer binary path.

filesystemPaths.gitPolicy: tracked only as .gitkeep; processing contents ignored

generatedArtifacts.purpose: Generated G-code and previews before external publish.
Local job evidence, ignored because it can contain private paths/source URLs.

hardBoundaries: Do not communicate with the printer.
Do not mount, unmount, format, erase, or otherwise manage SD cards.
Do not build or invent slicing settings dynamically; use checked-in profiles only.
Never commit model inputs, generated G-code, previews, or private evidence.
standardWorkflow: Import source into projects/<id>/todo and extract/process under projects/<id>/in-process.
List discovered STLs and ask the user if more than one printable STL is found.
Slice with the selected checked-in profile and write G-code/previews to projects/<id>/done.
If /Volumes/3D_PRINTS is already mounted, copy the final G-code there; otherwise report the local output path.
After external publish is verified, remove processing files and archive evidence only.
fallbackWorkflow: If PrusaSlicer is not on PATH, use PRUSA_SLICER_BIN or --prusa-slicer.
If direct Thingiverse ZIP download fails, use agent-browser fallback when available.
If browser fallback fails, ask the user to manually download the STL/ZIP and rerun convert.
safetyRules: Use safe ZIP extraction and reject unsafe archive paths.
Validate STL parseability, geometry, and build volume before slicing.
Evidence is local and ignored by default.
knownLimitations: Preview SVGs are sanity checks parsed from G-code and do not replace slicer/printer validation.
